transactions.counterparty: Bevillesta Pty Limited as trustee for the John Beville (Bankstown) Trust
transactions.citation: p40/p62: acquisition of a 75% effective interest in Top Ryde City Shopping Centre for A$393.8 million from Bevillesta Pty Limited as trustee for the John Beville (Bankstown) Trust, completed 19 December 2025; independent valuation as at 31 Dec 2025 S$337.597m
transactions.notes: Acquisition — gain_loss_pct left null per spec (five fields are for divestments); acquisition price S$334.8m is ~0.83% below the independent valuation S$337.597m as at 31 Dec 2025, kept out of gain_loss_pct to avoid conflating an acquisition discount with a divestment gain. Local-currency consideration A$393.8 million. Keppel REIT's first pure-play retail asset. Audited FYE2025 carrying value S$327,405k.

transactions.property_name: Marina Bay Financial Centre Tower 3 (additional one-third interest)
transactions.citation: p40/p62: acquisition of an additional one-third interest in Marina Bay Financial Centre Tower 3 at an agreed property value of S$1,453.0 million from Sageland Private Limited, completed 31 December 2025, raising Keppel REIT's aggregate interest in the asset to two-third
transactions.notes: Additional stake acquisition — interest_pct 0.3333 is the incremental one-third acquired, not the resulting two-third total holding. Raised via equity-accounted JV Central Boulevard Development Pte. Ltd. No separate independent valuation of the acquired one-third stake was disclosed; the only as-at 31 Dec 2025 independent valuation (S$2,934.7m, Colliers) is for the aggregate two-third interest held after the deal, so gain_loss_pct/reference_value are left null rather than derived by improperly mixing a whole-position valuation against a partial-stake price.
